# Changed-requirement experiments (auto-generated by `python -m triage.change_request`)

## Scenario 1 - missing an urgent case now costs 300 instead of 100

All numbers are evaluated under the NEW (strict) cost model. 'Old thresholds' = the thresholds tuned under the old penalty. 'Re-tuned' = thresholds re-chosen under the new penalty on out-of-fold data; no retraining, no code change except one number in `triage/config.py`.


### random regime (mean over 5 seeds)

| approach | policy | cost/100 (strict) | urgent recall | urgent missed / seed | abstain rate | mean t_urgent |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A_rules_baseline | no tunable threshold | 1659.0 ± 243.8 | 72.5% | 9.2 | 27.0% | - |
| B_tfidf_logreg | old thresholds (do nothing) | 154.1 ± 83.7 | 98.9% | 0.4 | 10.9% | 0.26 |
| B_tfidf_logreg | re-tuned thresholds | 154.1 ± 83.7 | 98.9% | 0.4 | 10.9% | 0.26 |
| C+_with_safety_net | old thresholds (do nothing) | 139.2 ± 92.7 | 98.7% | 0.4 | 12.7% | 0.16 |
| C+_with_safety_net | re-tuned thresholds | 139.2 ± 92.7 | 98.7% | 0.4 | 12.7% | 0.16 |
| C_plus_rule_features | old thresholds (do nothing) | 133.7 ± 95.1 | 98.7% | 0.4 | 12.7% | 0.16 |
| C_plus_rule_features | re-tuned thresholds | 133.7 ± 95.1 | 98.7% | 0.4 | 12.7% | 0.16 |

### template regime (mean over 5 seeds)

| approach | policy | cost/100 (strict) | urgent recall | urgent missed / seed | abstain rate | mean t_urgent |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|

Re-tuning both cost models (grid of 323 threshold pairs x 2) took ~9.6s at most.


## Scenario 2 - new category `cold_chain_excursion`

Config change needed: `ROUTE_TABLE['cold_chain_excursion'] = 'quality_assurance'` (already in `triage/config.py`). The models below are re-trained from labelled examples only.

`same_template`: new-category test reports share phrasing with the labelled new-category examples (optimistic). `new_template`: whole templates held out (harsh).

### Rules baseline before/after hand-written rules (no labelled data, no training)

| new_template | A_rules_baseline + category regex + urgency regex | 90% | 6% | 4% | 100% | 97 | 87.7% | 12.7 |
